subject: Cascade Recovery: RTO/RPO evidence & DR test logs
messages:
From: Michael Turner <m.turner@acmetrust.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmetrust.com
Date: 2025-05-22T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: BCP questionnaire + RTO/RPO evidence request

David —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our diligence for the upcoming procurement review we need a concise set of artifacts to validate Redwood's recovery posture. Can you please provide the following by end of next week?

1) Primary recovery runbook (high-level steps for warm failover and full restore).
2) RTO and RPO statements for hosted inference (typical production topology) and for Dedicated/Private offerings.
3) Logs or snapshots from the most recent three failover exercises (dates + short notes).
4) KV cache warm timings / prefix-cache behaviors you rely on for recovery.
5) Backup retention policy and evidence of backups (chain-of-custody notes if possible).
6) A pointer to any video recording or witness evidence from the last live witness test.

I attached our intake spreadsheet (Acme_BCP_Questionnaire.xlsx) with preferred answer formats. If anything is sensitive and needs an NDA/portal we can accommodate.

Best,
Mike
Michael Turner
Director, Vendor Risk
AcmeTrust Financial
(Attachment: Acme_BCP_Questionnaire.xlsx)

Mike —

Appreciate the clear list. We'll assemble a packet and get it over to you. Quick notes up front:
- We can provide a sanitized recovery runbook and the RTO/RPO by offering (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).
- Recent witness tests: 2025-03-10, 2025-01-15, 2024-11-20 — we'll attach the summary logs and timestamps.
- KV cache warm timings differ by model/quantization; we'll include representative samples and a short explanation.

Attaching an overview packet to start (redwood_bcp_overview.pdf). Jordan — can you pull the last three exercise logs and the daily KV snapshot and drop links? Grace — please pull the retention policy excerpt and a short chain-of-custody note for backups.

Can we aim to share the complete packet by 2025-05-29? If you prefer a short sync to walk through artifacts, propose a 30-min window next Tuesday or Wednesday.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Head of Customer Security & Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Turner <m.turner@acmetrust.com>

Date: 2025-05-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BCP questionnaire + RTO/RPO evidence request

David —

Thanks. A couple clarifications from our side:
- For the RTO number, can you provide a typical median and a worst-case observed during your most recent test? We need both so our SREs can map expectations against our SLAs.
- For KV warm timings, can you give a compact table for small/medium/large models (e.g., 1K, 4K, 16K token seq) rather than long logs?
- We'll need a signed attestation (.pdf) that the attached logs are unmodified extracts from production test runs (a simple statement + signature is fine).

If you can include a Drive link for the video/test recording that would be ideal.

Regards,
Mike
(Attachment: Acme_BCP_Questionnaire.xlsx)

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-05-27T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pull logs for AcmeTrust request

Ops team —
Please export the following and confirm checksums:
- Exercise summaries for tests dated 2025-03-10, 2025-01-15, 2024-11-20 (attached: exercise_summaries.zip stub).
- Daily KV snapshot for 2025-05-21 (attached: daily_kv_snapshot_20250521.log).
- Short table: KV warm times for model sizes 1K/4K/16K under our standard warm strategy.

Responses below.

Answers for AcmeTrust:
- RTO (Hosted API): median 90s, observed worst-case during test 420s (root-cause: control-plane throttle followed by cache rebuild).
- RPO: Hosted API typical 15s (KV prefix persistence + continuous WAL replication), Dedicated: 5s, Private: variable based on customer storage config (documented in attach).
- KV warm times (representative): 1K -> 12s, 4K -> 38s, 16K -> 140s (these are median warmstart numbers on T4-equivalent warm nodes, see notes).
- Backups: nightly snapshots retained 30 days by default for Hosted; Dedicated customers can elect 90/365 day retention. Chain-of-custody: backups are produced by orchestrator with signed manifest; excerpt attached.

Attachments included (stubs): daily_kv_snapshot_20250521.log, exercise_summaries.zip (summaries), dr_test_video_link.txt (Drive link to 2025-03-10 witness recording).

-- Jordan Blake
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
